name: Snow Squarestem
desc: Snow Squarestem (Melanthera nivea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Melanthera nivea, also known as pineland squarestem, snow squarestem and Spanish: yerba de cabra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It grows in the Americas.
